# StackHal.com — Developer Tools & Infrastructure Diagnostics

> Free online developer tools and engineering field notes by backend engineer Bahdan Hal: Apple PKPass Inspector, Technical SEO Audit, GEO Readiness Analyzer, and AI Studio Local File Sync.

## Public pages

- [Apple Wallet (.pkpass) Inspector](https://stackhal.com/apple-pkpass-inspector): debug Apple Wallet passes, examine manifest hashes, JSON schemas, and preview passes
- [Technical SEO Audit](https://stackhal.com/seo-audit): deterministic crawling, redirect loops, canonical integrity, robots.txt, and sitemap audits
- [GEO Readiness Analyzer](https://stackhal.com/geo-audit): deterministic answer-engine crawlability and AI readiness analysis
- [AI Studio Local File Sync & Codebase Context](https://stackhal.com/ai-studio-local-file-sync): open-source Chrome extension for packing repository context, reviewing AI-generated diffs, and syncing approved files to a local workspace
- [Engineering Blog](https://stackhal.com/blog): technical investigations and field notes
- [Agent Conversations](https://stackhal.com/agent-conversations): periodic digests of notable agent discussions

## Ecosystem applications

- [Bahdan Hal Portfolio](https://bahdanhal.pl/): backend consulting and production engineering
- [IleZa.pl](https://ileza.pl/): Manual editorial fair prices for any product category in Poland, plus a salary calculator

## Data access

- Public read-only MCP endpoint: `https://stackhal.com/mcp`
- Public MCP tools: `audit_website_seo`, `analyze_geo_readiness`, `inspect_domain_security`, `transpile_to_caddyfile`, `inspect_apple_pkpass`, `calculate_cidr_overlap`, `generate_favicon_suite`, `transpile_regex_engine`, `trace_dns_delegation`, `validate_app_links`, `diagnose_cors_policy`.
- No account or API key is required.
